stemMd: Some poets are architects. No architect in this group is retired. Which claim cannot be true?

options.label: A
options.textMd: No retired person is an architect in the group.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Every poet in the group is retired.

explanationMd: At least one poet is an architect, and every architect in the group is not retired. Therefore at least one poet is not retired, contradicting the claim that every poet is retired. The other claims are compatible with the premises.

distractorRationale.d: This follows from the poet-architect overlap.
distractorRationale.b: The premises do not rule out additional architects.
distractorRationale.c: The premises allow poets outside the overlap.
distractorRationale.a: This is equivalent to the second premise.
